# PROJECT SUMMARY
This repository implements a Hybrid Claim Analysis System for real-time food safety risk monitoring and forecasting. The system operates on two tracks: Track A (Operational) provides lightweight real-time dashboards using statistical methods, while Track B (Simulation) uses advanced ML/DL models for precise future predictions. The system manages 54 standardized claim fields stored in partitioned Parquet format and applies advanced risk scoring using Nelson Rules, CUSUM, and statistical distributions.

# FILE MAP

## Root
app.py - Main dashboard control tower with KPI metrics, risk radar, and trend visualization
requirements.txt - Python dependencies including Streamlit, Pandas, CatBoost, and Prophet

## Core Modules (core/)
core/__init__.py - Package initialization
core/config.py - Central configuration defining 54 target claim fields and system constants
core/storage.py - Parquet partitioning I/O and unified data loader with filtering capabilities
core/etl.py - Extract-Transform-Load module for data validation and 54-field extraction
core/analytics.py - Advanced risk scoring engine using Nelson Rules, CUSUM, and statistical methods
core/forecasting.py - Track A lightweight forecasting engine using ensemble methods (Run-rate + MoM + SARIMA)

## Engine Modules (core/engine/)
core/engine/__init__.py - Engine package initialization
core/engine/trainer.py - Track B simulation engine for ML/DL model training with Optuna optimization
core/engine/models.py - Model definitions and utilities for simulation experiments
core/engine/allocator.py - Top-down allocation logic for distributing predictions across categories

## Pages (Streamlit Multi-Page App)
pages/1_데이터_업로드.py - Data upload interface for CSV/Excel claim files
pages/2_매출수량_관리.py - Sales volume management and historical data tracking
pages/3_플랜트_분석.py - Deep dive plant-level analysis and diagnosis
pages/4_예측_시뮬레이션.py - Future simulation and forecasting interface with model comparison

## Scripts
scripts/run_phase1_verification.py - Phase 1 verification and testing script
scripts/run_phase1_5_verification.py - Phase 1.5 verification script
scripts/generate_series_and_report.py - Time series generation and reporting utility
scripts/patch_app_trend.py - App trend patching utility

## Documentation
docs/project_master.md - Project master documentation with architecture and status
docs/README.md - Documentation index
docs/copilot_instruction.md - Development guidelines for AI assistants
docs/refactor_spec.md - Refactoring specifications
docs/milestone.md - Project milestones and progress tracking

## Configuration
.github/copilot-instructions.md - GitHub Copilot configuration with Karpathy Guidelines
.gitignore - Git ignore patterns for data, models, and Python artifacts

## Data Storage (Not in Repository)
data/hub/ - Partitioned Parquet storage organized by 접수년/접수월 (YYYY/MM)
data/sales/ - Sales history data in Parquet format
data/models/ - Trained ML/DL model artifacts
data/series/ - Time series data for analysis

## Test Files
test_forecast.py - Forecasting engine unit tests
test_ensemble.py - Ensemble method validation tests
test_mom_calculation.py - Month-over-month calculation tests
test_runrate_ensemble.py - Run-rate ensemble tests

# TECH STACK

## Languages
Python 3.10+ - Primary development language

## Web Framework
Streamlit 1.31.1 - Interactive dashboard and multi-page web application

## Data Processing
Pandas 2.1.4 - Data manipulation and analysis
NumPy 1.24.3 - Numerical computing
PyArrow 14.0.1 - Parquet file format and columnar data processing
Openpyxl 3.1.2 - Excel file handling

## Visualization
Plotly - Interactive charts and graphs
Matplotlib 3.8.2 - Statistical plotting

## Machine Learning & Statistics (Track B)
CatBoost 1.2.1 - Gradient boosting for tabular data
Prophet - Time series forecasting
Statsmodels 0.14.0 - Statistical modeling and SARIMAX
Optuna 3.14.0 - Hyperparameter optimization framework
Scikit-learn 1.3.2 - Machine learning utilities and metrics
LightGBM - Gradient boosting framework (via dependencies)

## Deep Learning (Track B)
PyTorch 2.1.1 - Neural network training and inference

## Utilities
python-dateutil 2.8.2 - Date manipulation and relative deltas
Joblib 1.3.2 - Model serialization and parallel processing
Requests 2.31.0 - HTTP library

## Development Tools
Pytest 7.4.3 - Testing framework
Black 23.12.1 - Code formatter
Flake8 6.1.0 - Linting and style checker
